description:
Join us for our INL Industry Days event this November. This in-person event will be November 11 and 12 at the Idaho National Lab Meeting Center. The two day event will feature guided lab tours, presentations from lab leadership and an exhibitor hall. 

Register at this link: https://inlhrfedramp.gov1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_8IGlm8qDfvZThsi
